summary: Frontend-only testing for Blunder Staff Recipe Manual. All core flows verified: seed render, category/search filters, size scaling math, password-protected edit mode, inline editing (name/amount), add/delete recipes, save & lock, and localStorage persistence after reload.
passed: Category tabs render (All/Smoothies/Salads/Bowls/Coffee); Salads tab filters grid
Search input filters recipes (search 'matcha' shows 1 result)
Size scaling math correct: Choco Banana Peanut Bark base 150g -> Small 99g, Medium 150g, Large 225g
Wrong password '1234' shows 'INCORRECT PASSWORD' error (data-testid=password-error) and stays locked
Correct password '0007' unlocks edit mode; modal closes and floating 'Edit Mode On' pill appears
Inline edit fields active in edit mode: name, ingredient amount, category, description, unit
Add Item card visible in edit mode; clicking adds a new recipe card (7 -> 8)
Delete button removes the card after window.confirm accept (8 -> 7)
Save & Lock exits edit mode: pill disappears, Edit button restored, fields become read-only (H2 instead of INPUT)
Edited ingredient amount updates the base value: Medium=200g (was 150g), Large=300g after edit
localStorage persistence: edited name 'Choco Banana TEST' and amount 200g both persist after full page reload
notes: Backend testing skipped per request (localStorage-only app). Toast overlays at top-right can transiently intercept the Save button click during automated tests immediately after add/delete actions; resolved by waiting for toasts to fade or dispatching via JS. Functionally Save works correctly in normal user flow.
